title: She bought a glass vase for £1 at Scottish car-boot sale, used it as a plant pot; it sold for £32,450
summary_full: In 2008, a woman bought a glass vase for just £1 at a car-boot sale in Dumfries, Scotland, and used it as a plant pot. She later discovered it was a rare 1929 creation by French designer René Lalique. After experts valued it at £25,000 on Antiques Roadshow, the vase sold at Christie’s in London for £32,450.
